project.description: The name of the project in which to place the Signal Store.  Valid for any Angular project type except testing.
project.x-prompt: What project would you like to add the Signal Store?

directory.description: A directory where the Signal Store is placed, relative to the 'lib' folder of the project's source root. If not provided, the Signal Store will be placed in the 'stores' folder.

addEntities.description: Add entity collection support to the Signal Store with `withEntities`, and an entity type to go with it.

export.description: Whether to export the generated file as part of the public API of the project.

providedInRoot.description: If true, the Signal Store will be provided in the root injector.  If false, the store will need to be provided manually.

skipEvents.description: Skip adding an event group, created with `eventGroup`, to the Signal Store.

skipLogger.description: Skip adding logger feature to the Signal Store.
